name: timeline
description: A horizontal timeline with 2–8 ordered milestones. Choose this scene for ANY request about a sequence of events over time — a project plan, a patient care pathway, a historical sequence, a study or trial timeline. All spacing and label placement is computed for you; set `emphasize` on a milestone to call it out.

start_label.description: Small caption at the left end of the line, e.g. "Diagnosis".

end_label.description: Small caption at the right end of the line, e.g. "Today".

sublabel.description: Short secondary text shown alongside the label.

emphasize.description: Draws this milestone larger, in the accent color.

element_ids.line: the horizontal timeline arrow (with start_label/end_label captions when set)
element_ids.dot_<i>: the marker for milestone i (0-indexed, left to right)
element_ids.label_<i>: milestone i's label (and sublabel, when set)
element_ids.title: figure title, when set

examples.request: Draw a timeline of a research project from kickoff to the final report.
Show a timeline from diagnosis to follow-up, with treatment as the key event.
